parent="layer-ann" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;shadow=1;align=left;spacingLeft=15;spacingTop=10;" value="<font style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #7f6000;">SecureScan-AI Platform</font><br><font style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #333333;">Level 1 Threat Modeling Data Flow Diagram (DFD)</font><br><font style="font-size: 10px; color: #555555;">Standard: Yourdon-DeMarco &amp; Microsoft SDL | Security Framework: OWASP Top 10:2021<br>Boundaries: TB1–TB6 | Entities: EE1–EE4 | Processes: P1–P6 | Stores: DS1–DS4 | Flows: DF1–DF11</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="270" x="50" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ann_legend" parent="layer-ann" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;shadow=1;align=left;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=12;fontColor=#333333;" value="<b>DIAGRAM LEGEND &amp; NOTATION HIERARCHY</b><br><br><b>[TB1–TB6] Trust Boundaries:</b> Grey Dashed Enclosures defining perimeter isolation &amp; privilege tiers.<br><b>[EE1–EE4] External Entities:</b> Blue Rectangles representing human users (Dev, Manager, Admin) &amp; Cloud IdP.<br><b>[P1–P6] Processes:</b> Green Rounded Rectangles representing services &amp; containerized execution nodes.<br><b>[DS1–DS4] Data Stores:</b> Orange Cylinders representing persistent databases, registries, vaults &amp; audit trails.<br><b>[DF1–DF11] Data Flows:</b> Solid Black Directed Arrows denoting authenticated payloads and token-mediated exchanges.<br><b>[Annotations]:</b> Yellow Cards detailing architectural controls, trust assumptions &amp; security governance." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="1560" x="50" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ann_notes" parent="layer-ann" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;shadow=1;align=left;spacingLeft=20;spacingTop=12;fontColor=#333333;" value="<b>ARCHITECTURAL THREAT MITIGATION SPECIFICATIONS (STRIDE ALIGNED)</b><br><br><b>1. Spoofing Mitigation (EE1/EE4/P2):</b> All ingress requests terminate TLS 1.3 at P1. OIDC tokens cryptographically verified by P2; internal microservices require mutual TLS (mTLS) with ephemeral X.509 certs.<br><b>2. Tampering Mitigation (P4/DS2):</b> Scanner containers execute with read-only root filesystems, dropped Linux capabilities (CAP_DROP_ALL), and gVisor sandboxing. Container images signed via Cosign in DS2.<br><b>3. Repudiation Mitigation (DS4/P1):</b> High-fidelity security audit events stream directly to immutable append-only SIEM store (DS4). Cryptographic hash chaining prevents log alteration.<br><b>4. Information Disclosure Mitigation (DS1/DS3):</b> DS1 enforces AES-256 transparent data encryption at rest. Sensitive source code in P4 is held in transient memory tmpfs mounts and purged immediately.<br><b>5. Denial of Service Mitigation (P1/P3):</b> API Gateway P1 implements token-bucket rate limiting by IP and User-ID. Scan Orchestrator P3 enforces queue quotas, max runtime timeouts, and container memory limits.<br><b>6. Elevation of Privilege Mitigation (P1/P2/EE3):</b> Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across API routes. Unprivileged runner P4 is prohibited from mounting the host Docker daemon socket." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="1560" x="50" y="895" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.span: Level 1 Threat Modeling Data Flow Diagram (DFD)

Standard: Yourdon-DeMarco & Microsoft SDL | Security Framework: OWASP Top 10:2021
Boundaries: TB1–TB6 | Entities: EE1–EE4 | Processes: P1–P6 | Stores: DS1–DS4 | Flows: DF1–DF11

text.tspan: Level 1 Threat Modeling Data Flow Diagram

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1538px; height: 1px; padding-top: 781px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#333333, #c1c1c1); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
DIAGRAM LEGEND & NOTATION HIERARCHY
[TB1–TB6] Trust Boundaries: Grey Dashed Enclosures defining perimeter isolation & privilege tiers.
[EE1–EE4] External Entities: Blue Rectangles representing human users (Dev, Manager, Admin) & Cloud IdP.
[P1–P6] Processes: Green Rounded Rectangles representing services & containerized execution nodes.
[DS1–DS4] Data Stores: Orange Cylinders representing persistent databases, registries, vaults & audit trails.
[DF1–DF11] Data Flows: Solid Black Directed Arrows denoting authenticated payloads and token-mediated exchanges.
[Annotations]: Yellow Cards detailing architectural controls, trust assumptions & security governance.

text.tspan: [TB1–TB6] Trust Boundaries: Grey Dashed Enclosures defining perimeter isolation & privilege tiers.
[EE1–EE4] External Entities: Blue Rectangles representing human users (Dev, Manager, Admin) & Cloud IdP.
[P1–P6] Processes: Green Rounded Rectangles representing services & containerized execution nodes.
[DS1–DS4] Data Stores: Orange Cylinders representing persistent databases, registries, vaults & audit trails.
[DF1–DF11] Data Flows: Solid Black Directed Arrows denoting authenticated payloads and token-mediated exchanges.
[Annotations]: Yellow Cards detailing architectural controls, trust assumptions & security governance.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1538px; height: 1px; padding-top: 956px; margin-left: 27px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#333333, #c1c1c1); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
ARCHITECTURAL THREAT MITIGATION SPECIFICATIONS (STRIDE ALIGNED)
1. Spoofing Mitigation (EE1/EE4/P2): All ingress requests terminate TLS 1.3 at P1. OIDC tokens cryptographically verified by P2; internal microservices require mutual TLS (mTLS) with ephemeral X.509 certs.
2. Tampering Mitigation (P4/DS2): Scanner containers execute with read-only root filesystems, dropped Linux capabilities (CAP_DROP_ALL), and gVisor sandboxing. Container images signed via Cosign in DS2.
3. Repudiation Mitigation (DS4/P1): High-fidelity security audit events stream directly to immutable append-only SIEM store (DS4). Cryptographic hash chaining prevents log alteration.
4. Information Disclosure Mitigation (DS1/DS3): DS1 enforces AES-256 transparent data encryption at rest. Sensitive source code in P4 is held in transient memory tmpfs mounts and purged immediately.
5. Denial of Service Mitigation (P1/P3): API Gateway P1 implements token-bucket rate limiting by IP and User-ID. Scan Orchestrator P3 enforces queue quotas, max runtime timeouts, and container memory limits.
6. Elevation of Privilege Mitigation (P1/P2/EE3): Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across API routes. Unprivileged runner P4 is prohibited from mounting the host Docker daemon socket.

text.tspan: 1. Spoofing Mitigation (EE1/EE4/P2): All ingress requests terminate TLS 1.3 at P1. OIDC tokens cryptographically verified by P2; internal microservices require mutual TLS (mTLS) with ephemeral X.509 certs.

2. Tampering Mitigation (P4/DS2): Scanner containers execute with read-only root filesystems, dropped Linux capabilities (CAP_DROP_ALL), and gVisor sandboxing. Container images signed via Cosign in DS2.
3. Repudiation Mitigation (DS4/P1): High-fidelity security audit events stream directly to immutable append-only SIEM store (DS4). Cryptographic hash chaining prevents log alteration.
4. Information Disclosure Mitigation (DS1/DS3): DS1 enforces AES-256 transparent data encryption at rest. Sensitive source code in P4 is held in transient memory tmpfs mounts and purged immediately.

5. Denial of Service Mitigation (P1/P3): API Gateway P1 implements token-bucket rate limiting by IP and User-ID. Scan Orchestrator P3 enforces queue quotas, max runtime timeouts, and container memory limits.
6. Elevation of Privilege Mitigation (P1/P2/EE3): Strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enforced across API routes. Unprivileged runner P4 is prohibited from mounting the host Docker daemon socket.
